divergences.reason: Pinned upstream's js::utf16 helper removes the N-API synthetic terminator before truncation, preventing a phantom U+0000 from leaking into padded output for non-ASCII text.
Pinned upstream preserves ESC+b/f as literal Alt letters when Kitty mixed mode is active; navigation aliases remain in legacy mode only.
Pinned upstream preserves ESC+B/F as historical navigation aliases in legacy mode, matching the lowercase alias behavior.
Pinned upstream accepts legacy Ctrl+Alt+letter ESC pairs even when enhanced keyboard reporting is active, supporting mixed-mode terminals.
Pinned upstream recognizes the terminal's shared 0x1f encoding for Ctrl+- in addition to the existing Ctrl+_ name.
Pinned upstream does not dispatch unmodified non-Latin text through its physical base-layout key, preventing Cyrillic text from triggering a plain Latin shortcut.
Pinned upstream treats keypad digit keycodes as text even when the terminal omits the NumLock modifier bit.

nonAdoptions.reason: Retain GJC's 2-cell compatibility-jamo and U+3164 widths on macOS. The pinned upstream platform default is one cell for compatibility jamo on macOS and does not widen U+3164, while the existing IME cursor contract and pre-sync golden require two cells.
